units.source_text: 良子把我一把拽了上來，還幫我包紮了右手臂上的傷口，

en.t: Yoshiko pulled me up in one tug and even bandaged the wound on my right arm,

units.source_text: 當時她表情認真地說：「你喝太多了吧。」

en.t: and at the time, with a serious look, she said, "You have been drinking too much."

units.source_text: 我並不在乎死，但若是因受傷流血變成殘廢，我寧死不願。

en.t: I did not mind dying, but if I were to become disabled from being injured and bleeding, I would rather die.

units.source_text: 我一邊讓良子給我包紮手臂上的傷口，心裡一邊想，自己真的該戒酒了。

en.t: As I let Yoshiko bandage the wound on my arm, I thought to myself that I really ought to give up drinking.

units.source_text: 「我戒酒。從明天起，我滴酒不沾。」

en.t: "I will quit drinking. Starting tomorrow, I will not touch a drop."

units.source_text: 「真的？」「我一定戒，如果我戒了，良子，你願意嫁給我嗎？」

en.t: "Really?" "I will definitely quit. If I do, Yoshiko, will you marry me?"

units.source_text: 其實，讓她嫁給我是一句玩笑話而已。

en.t: In truth, asking her to marry me was only a joke.
"Of course" was a shortened form of "of course, of course."

units.source_text: 當時流行著各種略稱，如「摩男」「摩女」（新潮摩登男女之意）等。

en.t: At the time, all sorts of abbreviations were in fashion, such as "modern boy" and "modern girl," meaning stylish modern young men and women.
